newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Oct index rose to 56.9.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Oct index rose to 56.9.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 56.9 in October from 56.3 in September, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Thursday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index fell to 50.7 in October from 59.3 in September.
The employment component of the barometer fell to 48.8 in October from 50.8 in September.

(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said "the October survey is a generally strong report marked by stable prices paid."
The association said production and new orders continued to expand in October. It added that the drop in prices paid moved the prices component to nearly neutral.
